dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Chiefs Reach 8-2 Record; Face Buffalo in High-Stakes Short-Week Test
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Kansas City improved to 8-2 following a Week 11 victory over Arizona, maintaining a top-five AFC seed despite league-worst field goal efficiency and significant offensive line injuries.
bullets: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes noted the offense is "getting better and better" after a Week 11 performance featuring a 26-yard sideline grab by Cyrus Allen and a 20-yard completion to Xavier Worthy [S9](https://www.chiefs.com/video/patrick-mahomes-on-the-offense-you-can-see-the-offense-getting-better-and-better-postgame-press-conference-nfl-week-11) [S13](https://www.chiefs.com/video/cyrus-allen-has-a-successful-26-yard-sideline-grab-to-end-third-quarter) [S14](https://www.chiefs.com/video/patrick-mahomes-pass-hits-xavier-worthy-for-20-yard-gain).

Head Coach Andy Reid praised the contributions of younger roster members in the win, while running back Emmett Johnson highlighted the efficiency of recent scoring drives [S7](https://www.chiefs.com/video/emmett-johnson-we-ve-been-having-great-drives-and-putting-up-points-postgame-press-conference-nfl-week-11) [S10](https://www.chiefs.com/video/andy-reid-love-seeing-these-young-guys-stepping-up-and-making-plays).

Statistical analysis identifies a critical vulnerability in the kicking game, where Kansas City ranks #32 in field goal percentage (63.2%) compared to Buffalo’s #1 ranked unit (100%) [S4](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50563342/week-11-sunday-games-takeaways-questions-2026).

Defensive end George Karlaftis emphasized a disciplined preparation focus for the upcoming Thursday night matchup against the 9-1 Bills, as the Chiefs navigate the absence of starting linemen Trey Smith and Jaylon Moore [S8](https://www.chiefs.com/video/george-karlaftis-on-future-matchups-one-practice-at-a-time-one-game-at-a-time-postgame-press-conference-nfl-week-11).
